text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? What's that gesture mean? You
cold?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, got it! Hot springs! You wanna try
a
Japanese-style bath, yeah?!

text_block_list.name: Foreigner
text_block_list.text: [Foreign Language]

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a busy street, I catch sight of
Tamamo Cross
and Oguri Cap
attempting to communicate with a

tourist from overseas.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No dice... I can't understand a thing,
'sides that
he's stressed out.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
He looks to be in a hurry. Do you think
it's
something urgent?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Rather, don'tcha think he's gettin' kinda
pale?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rumble...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's it! He's hungry!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nah! He's lookin' for the toilet!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Which makes this an emergency! Hey,
you
there—come help out!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon, mister! Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The closest toilet is over at the park!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Comin' through! Thanks for yer
cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Foreigner
text_block_list.text: [Foreign Language]

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! He left lookin' a lot happier,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
He must have been thanking us. It's a
good thing
we avoided disaster.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm surprised you recognized he
needed the
toilet.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I was as lost as you were at the start, but
when his
tummy rumbled and he went
pale, it clicked!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Plus, since I've always got you around, I
know
what "hungry" looks like—and that
wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Plus, since I've always got you around, I
know
what "hungry" looks like—an' he
wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
C-c'mon! I'm just tryin' to get on the
director's
good side!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're getting embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri! You promised to stop pointin'
that out!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? I don't remember making that
promise.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You promise promised!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, whatever. Nothin' wrong with bein'
friendly,
yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And if language gets in the way, I'll use
vibes!
That's just how I roll!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Th-thanks! Y'know, it's kinda
embarrassin' to be
told so straight!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right, she's very kind. She never
hesitates
to recommend the best places
for Kansai cuisine
or even just spots
where you can eat til you drop!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Why're your examples all 'bout food?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That you, Oguri? Gettin' hungry, huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
All this talk about food makes me want
to go to
one of those eat-till-you-drop
places again...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then let's grab a bite! Lunch never
tastes better
than it does after doin' a
good deed!
